title: LT-1 Pretrain Data
subtitle: Tokenized multi-domain pretraining corpus, SFT mix, and source for LT-1 (1.00B)
description: Pre-tokenized binary corpus (train_mix.bin, ~28.96M tokens), 8192-vocab BPE tokenizer (tokenizer_cosmo.json), causal-shifted conversational SFT dataset (sft_mix.pt, 19,933 pairs), and offline source bundle (lt1_src/) for the LT-1 1.00B CED-MoE-NCM language model.

resources.description: Memory-mapped uint16 token stream (~28.96M tokens across Cosmopedia, FineWeb-Edu, and domain corpora)
8192-vocabulary BPE tokenizer trained for LT-1 1B scale
19,933 causal-shifted conversational QA turns for supervised fine-tuning
